Inside Macintosh: Telephony /
Chapter 2 - Telephone Terminals / Telephone Terminals Reference

Result Codes

This section describes the result codes for the functions discussed in this chapter.
telNoErr
The function completed without error.
telAlreadyOpen
Terminal is already open.
telAPattNotSupp
Specified alerting pattern not supported by telephone tool.
telAutoAnsNotOn
Auto-answer feature is not turned on.
telBadAPattErr
Bad alerting pattern specified.
telBadDisplayMode
Bad display mode specified.
telBadDNErr
The directory number record is invalid or cannot be found.
telBadHandErr
The specified record handle is invalid.
telBadHTypeErr
Bad hookswitch type specified.
telBadLevelErr
Bad volume level setting specified.
telBadSampleRate
The wrong sample rate is set in the Sound control panel.
telBadTermErr
The telephone record handle is not valid.
telBadVTypeErr
Bad volume type setting specified.
telDisplayModeNotSupp
Specified display mode not supported by telephone tool.
telFeatActive
Specified feature is already active.
telFeatNotAvail
Specified feature is subscribed but not available.
telFeatNotSub
Specified feature is not subscribed.
telFeatNotSupp
Specified feature is not supported by telephone tool.
telHTypeNotSupp
Specified hookswitch type not supported by telephone tool.
telNoMemErr
Not enough memory is available.
telNoOpenErr
Unable to open terminal.
telStillNeeded
The terminal driver is still needed by another application.
telTermNotOpen
Specified terminal is not open.
telVTypeNotSupp
Specified volume type not supported by telephone tool.
